name: Rainbow Stage
source:
A short (10 minutes) original visual novel about a plus-sized person who starts up an idol group. Among the members include a transgender man, a person-of-color dancer, and a disabled singer.

[From the Itch.io page]
translation:
一部短篇（10分钟）原创视觉小说，讲述了一个大号人物创办偶像团体的故事。成员包括一名跨性别男子、一名有色人种舞者和一名残疾歌手。

[来自Itch.io页面]
